notes: Original title and authors verified in full paper HTML rendered by web retrieval from Scribd (15-page published article); direct terminal HTML did not expose text, so cached web-rendered extract is cited. Supplied original locator p.18 does not correspond to published pagination; matching Study 2A target result is on p.1116. Replication p and n are manually transcribed from the primary report figure, cached with figure URL. Original table means and test match replication report comparison. Replication narrative first describes a significant smaller effect and partial success, then explains differential attrition compromises randomization and concludes the work is inconclusive; final narrative verdict mapped to uninformative. No effect sizes converted.
